baseline.concentrationNote: Removing the top 3 winning stocks (of 70 that traded, out of 81 in the universe) reduces total return to approximately breakeven; removing the top 5 makes the strategy a net loser on every metric. 60% of traded stocks had negative expectancy.
baseline.datasetDescription: 81-stock hand-curated US large/mid-cap equity universe, 2020-01-02 to 2026-08-19. A single in-sample backtest window on a survivorship-biased, non-random universe — see PHASE_4_5_REPORT.md and MOMENTUM_DIAGNOSTICS_REPORT.md. Not yet validated out-of-sample (cross-universe replication and temporal holdout are the top-ranked next experiments).

bullish.note: Largest regime bucket by trade count. Approximately breakeven-to-negative in aggregate per the Phase 4.5 report; no feature reached an interesting effect size separating winners from losers in this regime in the diagnostics pass.

strong_bullish.note: Second-largest regime bucket; the highest win rate of the three regimes with meaningful trade counts.

neutral.note: The most differentiated regime in the diagnostics pass: winners were less overbought, better relative-strength performers, and further from recent highs than losers (multiple features at Cohen's d 0.5-1.2). Still exploratory/in-sample.
